verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a government foreigner-registration e-services portal. Such a portal could conceivably offer user-configured background automations like scheduled submissions or auto-renewal triggers, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only the front door: a script-only application shell at the root and a 404 on the long-published entry path. Nothing in it documents any automation, scheduling or background-execution capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
